purpose: Define the explicit registry/index of candidate canonical source artifacts and their source roles, canonical identities, physical locations and active/historical status.

topics.name: Canonical Source Registry
topics.purpose: Define the explicit registry/index of candidate canonical source artifacts and their source roles, canonical identities, physical locations and active/historical status.

semantics.identity_rule: Source artifact identity and canonical semantic identity are distinct.
semantics.location_rule: Filesystem path, archive member or remote locator is a physical binding.
semantics.role_rule: Every machine-significant source artifact declares/resolves an explicit source role.
semantics.duplicate_rule: Multiple physical artifacts may reference the same semantic identity only if source-role/precedence/reconciliation rules make the authoritative interpretation unambiguous.
semantics.active_rule: Active accepted definition sources are distinguishable from candidate, generated, historical and reconciliation sources.
semantics.reader_rule: Generic source readers can build the source set from the registry/manifest rather than filesystem naming heuristics.

invariants.rule: Canonical source resolution is deterministic, exact-identity based and provenance-preserving; filesystem location, transport or freshness never silently changes semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: source artifact has no source role
physical path used as semantic identity
same semantic identity has ambiguous competing active definitions
historical/generated source treated as active definition

references.purpose: Registry entries use explicit source roles.
